platform: Windows x86, MSVC 2022, meson debugoptimized export build with strict warnings

server.commandTemplate: fntech3.ded.exe +set com_gameProfile q3-ihv +set fs_basepath <installation> +set fs_homepath <isolated home> +set net_ip 127.0.0.1 +set net_enabled 1 +set net_port 27996 +set developer 1 +set dedicated 1 [+set rconpassword probe] +map tim_dm1

original.command: quake3.exe +set dedicated 0 +set r_fullscreen 0 +set vid_fullscreen 0 +set in_mouse 0 +set in_joystick 0 +set fs_basepath . +set gl_driver opengl32 +set gl_allowExtensions 0 +set r_nohwgamma 1 +set logfile 2 +set public 0 +set s_initsound 0 +set maxfps 10 +set developer 1 +exec ihvserveprobe.cfg (connect 127.0.0.1:27996; vstr-chained waits; screenshot; quit)

fntech3.commandTemplate: fntech3.exe +set com_gameProfile q3-ihv +set fs_basepath <installation> +set fs_homepath <isolated home> +set r_fullscreen 0 +set net_enabled 1 +set net_ip 127.0.0.1 +set cl_renderer <renderer> +exec probe.cfg (connect 127.0.0.1:27996; waits; screenshotPNG; quit)

getstatus.reply:
status
<argv1>
<serverinfo>
 then "%i %i "%s"
" per connected client while under 1400 bytes

directConnect.privateSlots: rconpassword matched by userinfo password opens privateclients
directConnect.reconnect: same base address and qport or port, after sv_reconnectlimit, no disconnect
directConnect.gameFirst: ClientConnect sees the userinfo before the slot is set up; a refusal leaves the slot free

gamestate.content: opcode 2, set configstrings, baselines with field 2, 0x94, 0x95 or word 4 set, zero byte

datagram.schedule: loopback every frame; silent over 1 s once a second; else max((bytes + 48) * 1000 / rate, snapshotMsec)

sendClientMessages.nonActive: empty message when reliable data waits or once a second
sendClientMessages.bots: built every frame, never sent, next time never advanced

ping.rule: mean of non-negative acked - sent over all 32 frames; 999 when none or above

spawn.reoffer: every client from connected on, bots included, to ClientConnect; refused dropped

finalMessage.sends: print and disconnect, twice, to every connected client

runs.name: final-both
steps: rcon map km_portal -> both re-sent the gamestate and began again
rcon clientkick 0 -> Original was kicked, disconnect on the original client

captures.shot0001.tga: e12f5e7dc9f6f4cd (console: entered the game, telefrag, kicked, disconnect)

earlierObservation: in a run before the final build, the original client's ping read 999 for 16 s after a level change; inferred from the original's arithmetic as stale per-frame acknowledgement stamps from the previous level, not compared live
fntech3Boundaries: getinfo's last field is the connected count
no second drop of a zombie or free slot
the engine's timeout check reads engine server time
fidelityCorrection: bot snapshots rebuilt every server frame instead of every snapshot interval
tests: tests/q3_ihv_game_bridge_tests.cpp (per-frame bot snapshots, network slot exemption)
portability: touched server sources pass GCC 13 and clang 18 -m32 syntax checks in WSL Ubuntu
open: the same scenes on the original server
